summary: Guarded destructive teardown of the dynamic-types ENGINE: DROP the dynamic_object_types registry table (owner ruling 2026-07-18; epic cinatra#1785 entry 95; closes #1793 — the engine is deleted LAST). The type model is now the dependency model: an object type exists ONLY as an explicit definition by an installed kind:artifact extension; every live type is registry-declared; the write path fail-closes with OBJECTS_TYPE_NOT_REGISTERED (packages/objects/src/mcp/handlers.ts — an unclassifiable/dynamic/tombstoned/unregistered save is REFUSED, never fallback-persisted); the two dynamic namespaces are permanently tombstoned (#1789, isTombstonedObjectTypeId); the generic floors were purged (#1792 core__0056 + #1785-A6 core__0059). dynamic_object_types is now DEAD substrate — the auto-registrar that wrote it and every read of it (classifier catalog merge, effective-type-catalog dynamic branch, the #1433 artifact-visibility-approval machinery, the Types & approvals UI, the object-type lifecycle actions) are deleted in this same PR, so the table produces and consumes nothing and is dropped outright. GUARDED (owner-ratified entry-95 interlock): the migration REFUSES (RAISEs a distinct EXCEPTION per unmet precondition, aborting the single all-or-nothing transaction so the table is never half-dropped) unless (a) ZERO non-retired artifact_type_claims reference a type still present in dynamic_object_types (claims key by object_type_id STRING, never an FK, and were NOT swept by the object-row purges — a residual non-retired claim would dangle); (b) the binding-reconcile queue is DRAINED of UNFINISHED (pending/failed) dynamic-type work, detected via the queue's OWN NOT-NULL denormalized object_type_id column (populated on BOTH axes — claim-side winner-transition type and write-side 'binding-reconcile-write' object type — so it is robust to the referenced object/claim-event row already being purged; a durable 'done' row is harmless history); (c) the #1792 projection purge has CONVERGED (no UNFINISHED graphiti_projection_outbox row — status <> 'done', which INCLUDES the transient 'processing' state — remains for an object whose type is still in dynamic_object_types). TABLE-EXISTENCE GUARDED: every check probes to_regclass for BOTH dynamic_object_types and the referenced table, so a fresh DB that NEVER had the table skips the whole guard and DROP TABLE IF EXISTS is a no-op (boot green with no table, AC#4), while a DB migrated from a populated table runs the guard against the real claim/queue/outbox tables and the drop removes it (AC#4). TRIGGER-AWARE (like core__0059): dynamic_object_types carries NO row triggers and NO table FKs point at it, so DROP TABLE needs no trigger-disable dance and no CASCADE — a plain DROP TABLE IF EXISTS removes the table + its own PK index cleanly; the discipline it inherits is the RIGOR (existence guards, distinct RAISEs, schema-qualifiable builders exported as data for the shape test, idempotency, refusing down()). COUPLED fresh-install mirror: the src/lib/drizzle-store.ts bootstrap CREATE TABLE + ALTER backfill for dynamic_object_types are removed in this same PR, so a fresh install never recreates the table. Idempotent/lineage-tolerant: on a second run or the fresh-bootstrap shape to_regclass is NULL, the guard is skipped and DROP TABLE IF EXISTS is a no-op. down() THROWS: irreversible clean-break teardown (0033/0048/0056/0059 precedent); roll back by restoring from a backup, not this migration. SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge — shipped max on origin/main at build time is core__0059 (purge-default-artifact-floor), so this is 0060; a concurrent lane may claim 0060 first, in which case renumber-at-merge is normal. migrations/** is HIGH-RISK: owner approval required; the lane never merges.
